title: Direct Tone-Matched Lip Compositing Pipeline
pipeline_description: kerat_liveportrait_warp.py v2 — pure-CV direct lip compositing. No neural nets (LP removed). Extracts lip region from LatentSync frames via MediaPipe 203-point face mesh, RANSAC affine-aligns driver lips into portrait crop space, Reinhard Lab colour-corrects lip patch to match source portrait, feathered-blends onto static source portrait frame-by-frame.

exit_codes.2: LP unavailable (mediapipe/cv2 import error) — triggers Reinhard fallback in TS

typescript_wiring.fallback: Step 3.5b Reinhard grade on exit code 2

gfpgan_wiring.stage: Step 3.7 (after LP warp, produces final output)
gfpgan_wiring.note: For dark/stylised Ker@ portraits, --skip-gfpgan recommended (GFPGAN restores faces to natural brightness, fighting portrait colour grade)

visual_review_note: Human must watch lp_warp_test_20260331_203650.mp4 to confirm (1) lips move naturally, (2) blend seam invisible, (3) dark portrait colour preserved. Gate is CONDITIONAL PASS until visual review confirms output quality.
